title: Retention Slate for Interactive Flows with Locale-Aware Evidence Exports
creator: Ava Nakamura
description: Build a unified, locale-aware retention configuration surface for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics that supports per-route TTLs, sampled retention modes, and automated evidence exports suitable for compliance reviews. This ticket scopes the PM work: product requirements, acceptance criteria, UX flow, rollout plan, developer SDK contract, and safety/backfill guidance for data already outside configured TTLs. The goal is a predictable, auditable retention operator that respects tenant residency, legal holds, and provides signed artifact bundles for regulators.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Per-route retention policies can be set via Console and API for prompts, responses, request logs, and metrics. 2) Policies accept: TTLs, sampling rates, residency override (region lock), and legal hold exemptions. 3) Automated evidence bundles (signed manifests + hash chain) can be generated for any retention window and exported to customer S3 or internal archive. 4) Console shows projected storage and cost delta per-policy and simulates policy effects on historical traffic. 5) SDK and API respect policy during live ingestion and during background purge/backfill. 6) Security review completed and KMS/HSM integration validated for exported artifacts.
tasks: Draft PRD and example API schema
Design Console panel for per-route TTL and sampling presets
Define SDK behavior for streaming requests with per-request residency hint
Implement evidence export manifest format and signing spec
Coordinate ENG for purge/backfill and retained-sample indexing
Run pilot with 2 enterprise customers and collect feedback
notes: We intentionally separate 'sampling' (keeps a deterministic subset for historic analysis) from 'retain-high-fidelity' (full prompt/response archival) to reduce customer storage cost while preserving auditability. Consider offering a default policy template per region and per-compliance regime (e.g., EU-Pseudonymized, US-Healthcare).
risks_and_tradeoffs:
- Stronger residency guarantees add routing complexity and may increase cross-region transfer costs.
- Aggressive sampling reduces audit surface if selection not cryptographically attested. We will require signed selection manifests for sampled cohorts.
- Immediate purge for PII-heavy routes risks breaking debugging and customer support; propose a temporary 'support escrow' with short TTL and gated RBAC.
outstanding_questions: What retention presets should be bundled for SOC2 vs GDPR vs HIPAA?
Should we support per-customer legal-hold overrides that bypass TTL until explicit release?
How will historical metrics aggregation be recomputed after partial purges?
